audio.completeHint: Your audio stays, and the model fills in the instruments it lacks. Needs a base model (ACE-Step 1.5 XL base).
audio.coverHint: The track keeps its structure, melody and groove in the described style. Lower closeness strays further: 0.3–0.5 for a change of genre.
audio.hint: A clip of your own — a beat, a riff, a song — for the track to sound like or to build on.
audio.legoHint: Your audio stays, and the model plays the chosen track over it. Needs a base model (ACE-Step 1.5 XL base).
audio.referenceHint: The track takes on its sound — timbre, mix, playing style — but not its melody or rhythm. The planner still runs.

music.defaultPrompt: Warm lo-fi hip hop, mellow Rhodes piano, vinyl crackle, laid-back drums
music.evicts: Composing evicts resident instances — the first track takes a while, then they reload.
music.none: No text-to-music model fits on these cards.
music.planHint: The planner fills in what is left open — tempo, key, duration, structure — before the track is rendered.
